title: List + reader
description: A list card beside a reader card (`ListReaderLayout`) with a sticky one-row `ReaderHeader` (wrapping title left, [•••] then one main action right, top-aligned, identical button height). Each panel scrolls independently on `AppShell page="fixed"` / `Page fixed` with zero hand-tuned `calc()`. Open item lives in `?open=` (`useDetailParam`) and `RouteHeader` breadcrumbs (`useRecordCrumb`); when the layout is too narrow for the list and a 360px reader (its own width, not the viewport), the reader replaces the list with a Back button.
when: Mail inboxes, support tickets, chat queues, notification centres or log viewers where people scan a list and read items side by side.

instead.need: A table or card grid where opening a record shows a modal overlay
A tool with a 380px control panel and live result

a11y: List and reader are named <section> landmarks; the open item marks aria-current="true" on its row; while the reader replaces the list (narrow layout) the Back button returns to the list and closes ?open=.
ReaderHeader keeps [•••] and the main action top-aligned at identical height with every secondary action inside •••.
notes: General pattern for every list + reader (mail, tickets, chat): title on the left (wraps), [•••] plus one main action on the right of the same row; every other action goes into •••.
Pass `recordTitle` to `ListReaderLayout` so the open record is appended to `RouteHeader` breadcrumbs via `useRecordCrumb`.

examples.title: In AppShell page="fixed"
examples.description: Full-height list + reader inside AppShell page="fixed" and Page layout="two-column" fixed (zero calc()). Full screen at /demo/list-reader/.
